I saved the date to GBrain and replied to Ilse in their #north-team thread to say it's noted and nothing else will be done with it.

- **What I saved:** "The next renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is 25 November." The note credits Ilse, the message ts and the time it was sent. It's a renewal date, not a money term, so it's fine to keep and share with the account team.
- **No conflict found:** I didn't find any other Brackenwater renewal date in GBrain. The brain runs on keyword search only, so a note worded differently might not have shown up.
- **The year:** Ilse didn't give one. The message was sent on 14 October 2026, so it most likely means 25 November 2026, but I saved it as they wrote it.
